description: Add daily water intake reminder functionality and improve the water tracker UX with an undo option for accidental logs, plus update DAILY_SUMMARY.md with today's findings
steps: In lib/screens/water/water_tracker_screen.dart: After the `await health.addWater(ml)` call in the quick-add buttons, change the SnackBar to include an 'UNDO' action button. The undo should call a deleteLastWaterLog method. Note: the FirestoreService already has deleteWaterLog(uid, logId). The tricky part is getting the new log's ID back. The addWater method in health_provider doesn't return the ID. Two approaches: (a) store the last added log's ID in local state for undo, or (b) use the todayWaterLogs list after the stream updates and delete the most recently added. Use approach (a): modify HealthProvider.addWater to return the String id from FirestoreService.addWaterLog, then store it for the undo button.

In lib/providers/health_provider.dart: Change `addWater` return type from `Future<void>` to `Future<String>` and return the result of `_firestoreService!.addWaterLog(_uid!, log)`. Also add a `deleteWaterLog(String logId)` method that delegates to `_firestoreService!.deleteWaterLog(_uid!, logId)`.

In lib/screens/water/water_tracker_screen.dart: Update the quick-add SnackBar to capture the returned ID and offer an Undo action that calls `health.deleteWaterLog(id)`. Use AppColors.limeBright for the undo text color.

Create/update DAILY_SUMMARY.md at the repo root with today's findings: what was fixed (firebase_auth import removal, auth exception handling, onboarding validation), what was added (water log undo), what needs attention (stale midnight subscriptions, reports month view, UPI placeholder, notification tap navigation, constants referencing Firebase).
acceptance_criteria: HealthProvider.addWater returns Future<String> with the new log ID
HealthProvider has a deleteWaterLog(String logId) method
Water tracker quick-add SnackBar shows an UNDO action that deletes the just-added log
DAILY_SUMMARY.md is updated with current date and comprehensive findings
verification: Read the modified files and confirm no syntax errors
Confirm the undo flow is logically correct (captures ID, passes it to delete)
findings: No Flutter SDK available - verified through code correctness review. addWater return type changed to Future<String?> (nullable) instead of Future<String> to safely handle the null guard at the top of the method. FirestoreService.addWaterLog confirmed to return Future<String>. deleteWaterLog already existed in FirestoreService. AppColors.limeBright confirmed present in app_theme.dart. DAILY_SUMMARY.md already existed (was modified, not created).
